Cloud Run background dispatch must persist requests and integrate with canonical run leases/checkpoints. Current in-process route behavior is not restart-safe transport.
Configuration/callback parity, current costs, final integration, immutable forward/recovery verification and production traffic cutover remain required.
Earlier two native temporary access windows are consumed and fully cleaned. New security-sensitive access needs a concrete action-time confirmation, not reuse of prior windows.
Global allocation admission across multiple Cloud Run processes and uncertain creation outcomes require explicit reconciliation before enabling production workers.
